review_locator: PMCID:PMC5551644, Binding Properties of the Transforming Growth Factor-beta Coreceptor Betaglycan; PMCID:PMC7175140, TGF-beta Signaling, betaglycan section
primary_title: TGF-beta2 uses the concave surface of its extended finger region to bind betaglycan's ZP domain via three residues specific to TGF-beta and inhibin-alpha
decision_basis: The reviews identify betaglycan/TGFBR3 as a high-affinity TGF-beta coreceptor, especially for TGF-beta2; the cited primary study maps direct TGF-beta2 binding to the betaglycan C-terminal ZP domain by NMR and SPR.
limitations_preserved: Direct TGF-beta2-betaglycan binding only; preserve the ZP-C domain and mature ligand context, and do not infer productive TGFBR1/TGFBR2 signaling from this binary edge.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7175140, TGF-beta Signaling, receptor assembly section; PMCID:PMC6800142, Specificity, versatility and control of TGF-beta family signaling
primary_title: Cooperative binding of transforming growth factor (TGF)-beta 2 to the types I and II TGF-beta receptors
decision_basis: The reviews describe cooperative TGF-beta2 receptor assembly; the primary COS-cell cross-linking and coimmunoprecipitation study shows that high-affinity TGF-beta2 binding requires coexpression of TGFBR1 and TGFBR2 and forms a hetero-oligomeric receptor complex.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TGF-beta2's weak intrinsic TGFBR2 affinity, cooperative TGFBR1/TGFBR2 coexpression, and betaglycan-facilitated alternative; no solved full ectodomain structure or SCI/terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC6800142, Specificity, versatility and control of TGF-beta family signaling
primary_title: Cooperative assembly of TGF-beta superfamily signaling complexes is mediated by two disparate mechanisms and distinct modes of receptor binding
decision_basis: The reviews identify TGF-beta3 as a cooperative heterotetrameric receptor ligand; the cited primary structure resolves TGF-beta3 with TGFBR1 and TGFBR2 ectodomains and shows receptor-receptor contacts are required for assembly and Smad activation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mature TGF-beta3 dimer, cooperative type-II-first assembly, receptor-receptor contact, and ectodomain/Smad assay boundaries; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4288046, Emerging roles of BMP9 and BMP10 in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia; PMCID:PMC6920675, Structural biology of betaglycan and endoglin
primary_title: Soluble endoglin specifically binds bone morphogenetic proteins 9 and 10 via its orphan domain, inhibits blood vessel formation, and suppresses tumor growth
decision_basis: The reviews identify endoglin as a direct BMP9/BMP10 coreceptor; the cited primary study measures high-affinity binding of BMP9 to soluble endoglin through its orphan domain and tests vascular-inhibitory function.
limitations_preserved: Direct soluble endoglin binding and vascular antagonism/presentation context; preserve the orphan-domain and soluble-versus-membrane boundary, and do not infer autonomous ENG signaling.

primary_title: Soluble endoglin specifically binds bone morphogenetic proteins 9 and 10 via its orphan domain, inhibits blood vessel formation, and suppresses tumor growth

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC5551644, Binding Properties of the TGF-beta Coreceptor Betaglycan
primary_title: Activin A inhibits BMP-signaling by binding ACVR2A and ACVR2B
decision_basis: The reviews identify activin A as a high-affinity type-II activin-receptor ligand; the cited primary myeloma/receptor study measures activin A binding and competition at ACVR2A and links it to antagonism of BMP signaling through shared type-II receptors.
limitations_preserved: Type-II receptor binding/competition only; preserve ACVR2A versus ACVR2B and do not infer ACVR1B recruitment or a productive complex from this binary edge.
